summary: Iteration 20 testing complete. Validated: regalia multi-picker endpoints (GET ?all=true, PUT /members/{id}/regalias with assign/unassign/hijack-protection/404), trip detail hardening (no ErrorBoundary across 4 featured packages + Cancún), Clubs tab on member dashboard, REGALÍAS ACTIVAS section shown only in edit mode, and commerce PUT regression. All 10 backend tests passed. Admin + Member UI flows verified end-to-end with no ErrorBoundary.

backend: GET /api/regalias?all=true returns global catalog for admin (ignores member_id filter)
GET /api/regalias?member_id=X filters to only regalias of that member
PUT /api/members/{id}/regalias attaches selected ids (count returned, re-GET verifies member_id persisted)
PUT /api/members/{id}/regalias detaches regalias removed from the list (sets member_id='')
PUT /api/members/{id}/regalias does NOT hijack regalias assigned to OTHER members (only touches this member's scope)
PUT /api/members/{id}/regalias returns 404 for non-existent member id
GET /api/packages/{id} returns dict; itinerary/includes/gallery are arrays when present
PUT /api/commerce/{id} persists changes; re-GET confirms update (regression)
frontend: Admin > Socios > Nuevo Socio modal: REGALÍAS ACTIVAS section is HIDDEN (only in edit mode — correct)
Admin > Socios > Editar (edit-member-0 testid): 'Editar Socio' modal opens with mf-regalias-section data-testid present and 'Regalías Activas' heading visible
Member Dashboard tabs correct: Inicio, Cupones, Regalías, Clubs, Cotizaciones, Anuncios, Solicitudes, Referidos, Beneficios — Familia correctly removed
Member > Clubs tab loads 'Clubs Vacacionales' heading with empty-state 'Sin clubs disponibles' (no clubs in DB after iter19 cleanup)
Member > Regalías tab loads OK (empty state for KT-001)

Trip detail /trip/{id} renders WITHOUT ErrorBoundary for 4 featured packages + Cancún (69dd8c80abf5138d2b22da3d) — no 'Algo salió mal' anywhere, Cancún page renders title, price Q.15,200, member price Q.11,500, description, Que Incluye section
No uncaught page errors during full flow (2 benign 401s from member-side fetches of admin-only endpoints)

critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/members/{id}/regalias overwrites regalia.member_id with the target member_id even if the caller forces an id that is currently owned by another member. UI disables those checkboxes, but a direct API call could 'hijack' a regalia. LOW risk for super_admin-only endpoint, but consider validating that each requested regalia currently has member_id in ('', target_member_id) and returning 409 otherwise (already noted by requester).
server.py size still ~2194 lines — splitting into routers (members/regalias/clubs/commerce/packages) recommended (>700 line threshold from previous iterations).

AdminMembers.js load effect only refetches regalias list AFTER save via setAllRegalias fresh fetch — current persistRegalias() re-fetches selection only. Good. But the global catalog (allRegalias) will NOT reflect newly assigned/unassigned member_id in the same session without an explicit refetch of /regalias?all=true. Consider refetching on save close or using optimistic update on allRegalias state so the 'asignada a otro' label updates across socios without refresh.
Member Dashboard grid updated to lg:grid-cols-9 — visually dense on mid screens. Consider responsive fallback to 2-3 rows on md breakpoint (minor UX).
TripDetailPage defensive guards (Array.isArray, fmtPrice, numeric coercion for memberPrice) confirmed; api wrapper used — no axios import remaining. Good.

Regalía list query still uses user.get('member_id','') when role is member/family — if a future member doc lacks member_id it would match regalias with empty string (unassigned) and leak them. Add explicit check 'if not member_id: return []' as guard.
seed_data_creation: Test suite created/cleaned 2 TEST_ members, 3 TEST_ regalias, 1 TEST_ commerce. All removed via DELETE with BORRAR YA code in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 adds: (1) admin socio edit form with regalia multi-picker (GET /api/regalias?all=true + PUT /api/members/{id}/regalias), picker HIDDEN in new-socio mode and SHOWN in edit mode only; checkboxes grey out with '(asignada a otro)' label for regalias owned by other members. (2) Member dashboard adds Clubs tab (MemberClubs component) alongside existing Regalías; tabs grid is lg:grid-cols-9. (3) TripDetailPage hardened with api wrapper + Array.isArray guards on itinerary/includes/gallery + numeric coercion for memberPrice + fmtPrice helper. Tested 4 featured packages + Cancún — NO ErrorBoundary reproduced in this iteration (prior transient bug not observable). Backend PUT endpoint currently trusts admin caller and will overwrite member_id on any regalia listed — documented as code review risk, not blocking.
rca of the issue: Trip ErrorBoundary 'Algo salió mal' not reproducible after iteration 20 fixes. Original cause was likely non-array itinerary/includes/gallery or NaN memberPrice — both fully defensively guarded now via Array.isArray and Number coercion in TripDetailPage. Across 5 distinct package IDs the page rendered without runtime errors.
